title: Rhodamine and functionalised azobenzene condensed fluorescent turn on novel receptor for the selective and sensitive detection of Hg2+: a combined experimental and theoretical study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30466-30481
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03890A, Paper
Open Access

Pradeep Sahu, Amit Kumar Chaturwedi, Ashok Raj Patel, Abhilash Pandey, Vanshika Sharma, Balaji Wamanrao Matore, Jagadish Singh, Partha Pratim Roy, Milan Hait, Goutam Kumar Patra
Azo-linked rhodamine based novel fluorescent–colorimetric chemosensor L for the detection of Hg2+ has been reported. The receptor L operates in wide range of pH and can be applied for the formation of INHIBIT type logic gate and real sample analysis.
